questions.title: Predict Virtual Function Output
questions.question: Given a Base class with a virtual show() and a Derived override, a Base pointer pointing to a Derived object calls show(). What is printed and why?

questions.title: Pointer Arithmetic on an Array
questions.question: With int arr[] = {10,20,30,40} and int* p = arr, what does *(p + 2) print? Explain how pointer arithmetic works here.

questions.title: Double Delete of Aliased Pointer
questions.question: Two pointers p and q point to the same heap int. After delete p; delete q; which line causes the problem and what kind of bug is this?

questions.title: Reverse a String Without Library Calls
questions.question: Reverse a string in place without using any built-in reverse function.

questions.title: Polymorphism Types with Code
questions.question: Explain compile-time vs runtime polymorphism in C++ with code, and what role virtual functions play. Interviewers also asked what a race condition is.

questions.title: Round Robin Time Quantum
questions.question: Explain process scheduling algorithms, especially Round Robin. How should the time quantum be chosen, and what happens if it is larger than every burst time?

questions.title: Semaphore vs Mutex
questions.question: What is a semaphore and how does it differ from a mutex? Follow-ups covered the critical section problem.

questions.title: Interrupts and Their Types
questions.question: What are interrupts, what types exist, and how does a processor handle one?

questions.title: Paging vs Segmentation
questions.question: How does paging work, and how is it different from segmentation? Also define deadlock.

questions.title: SQL Injection and Buffer Overflow
questions.question: Asked because of a security publication: explain SQL injection and buffer overflow attacks and how to protect a system against them.

questions.title: Remove Duplicates from a String
questions.question: Remove duplicate characters from a given string.

questions.title: Detect Loop in a Linked List
questions.question: Write a node-creation function, insert a node into a linked list, then detect whether the list has a cycle.

questions.title: Self-Referential Struct Size
questions.question: For struct Node { int data; Node *next; }, what is next? What happens if you remove the '*', and what is sizeof the struct?

questions.title: Two Sum
questions.question: Solve Two Sum; one interviewer asked for several different approaches.

questions.title: Palindrome Linked List
questions.question: Check whether a singly linked list is a palindrome.

questions.title: Memory Segments and Dynamic Allocation
questions.question: What are the memory regions of a C/C++ program? Explain malloc, calloc, new and delete and how they differ.

questions.title: Level Order Traversal and Queue
questions.question: Print the level order traversal of a binary tree; after using std::queue, implement the queue yourself.

questions.title: Print 1 to N Without Loops
questions.question: Print numbers from 1 to 100 (or 1 to N) without using any loop.

questions.title: Static Variables and Functions
questions.question: What does the static keyword do for variables and functions in C/C++? Compare static vs dynamic allocation.

questions.title: Lower Engineering Score Than School
questions.question: HR asked why the candidate's engineering score was lower than in 10th/12th, plus hobbies, strengths/weaknesses, plans for the next 4-5 years and why a master's later rather than now.

questions.title: Add Two Polynomials Using Linked Lists
questions.question: Represent two polynomials as linked lists and add them; also write a singly linked list from scratch in an online IDE.

questions.title: Struct vs Union vs Enum
questions.question: Explain struct, union and enum in C and when you would use each, along with pointer-related questions.

questions.title: Trailing Zeros in N Factorial
questions.question: Count the number of trailing zeros in n!. Start with brute force, then optimize and write pseudocode with complexity.

questions.title: Java vs Python
questions.question: Explain the pillars of OOP, compare Java and Python and their applications, and answer basic thread questions.

questions.title: What Leadership Means to You
questions.question: Where do you see yourself in five years, what do you expect from Intel, and what do you understand by leadership?

questions.title: JavaScript Hoisting and Equality
questions.question: Explain hoisting in JavaScript and the difference between == and ===; follow-ups on HTML tags, CSS properties, React and Redux.
